children: Nvidia faces risks beyond replacing a chief executive, Saxo Markets chief investment strategist Charu Chanana says. Questions about the future of Nvidia's China ambitions--its key partnerships and the broader AI vision that Huang has shaped could impact the chip giant's valuation, she notes. Nvidia's technology advantage won't disappear with his departure, but the board needs to show it can protect the business while addressing governance concerns, the strategist notes. "A credible successor and clear transition plan could help steady the shares," she adds, while an abrupt removal without either would leave investors facing much more uncertainty. Nvidia's shares are down 8.6% in after-hour trading. (sherry.qin@wsj.com)
